name: Dropbear SSH Repo
description: Standalone KPM repository for the dropbear-ssh package (on-demand SSH/SFTP over WiFi for jailbroken Kindles)

dropbear-ssh.name: Dropbear SSH
dropbear-ssh.author: Akshay
dropbear-ssh.description: On-demand SSH/SFTP server (dropbear, repackaged from notmarek/kindle-usbnetlite) over your existing WiFi — no USB networking needed. Launching opens a status app with a Start/Stop button (talks to a small loopback-only HTTP bridge on-device, no external server) showing the connect command and password while running. The server now correctly keeps running after closing the app (previously it didn't — confirmed and fixed via setsid). A random password is generated on install and printed in the KPM log; set your own any time by editing /mnt/us/usbnetlite/etc/ssh_password and restarting the server. Verified working on Kindle PaperWhite 4 (kernel 4.1.x, 2018-2022-era hardware) and Kindle Paperwhite 5 (kernel 4.9.77). Ships a second binary build for newer/older devices per upstream's own release split, selected automatically by kernel version at install time — that second build now also bundles libcrypt.so.1 for newer Kindle firmware (2024-era Paperwhite 6+) that doesn't ship it system-wide, a known issue shared with KOReader's own SSH plugin — unverified on real PW6 hardware as of this version, pending confirmation.
